aiMetadata.description: Creates a new task in a specific Google Tasks list, with optional notes, due date, and a completed flag. Use to add a to-do item for the authenticated user; requires a valid task-list ID (resolve it first if you only have a list name). Not idempotent: each call appends a separate task even with identical input.
